toolchain: UltraCombo's own MIPS-to-C and ADSP-2105-to-C translators
approach: The original MIPS R4600 game code and the sound board's ADSP-2105 code are statically translated to C and compiled on the player's PC at first launch; the arcade board around them is emulated
help: Netplay testing with a real second player
Testing the first-launch build on Windows 7 and 8
Load-time measurements from a real cabinet's hard drive
notes: v1.2.5 (pre-release): Windows zip, Linux tarball and AppImage. One program with a game picker for Killer Instinct (version 1.5d, 1.4 as an option) and Killer Instinct 2 (see .recomp-2.json). Plays the whole game, authentic by default, with optional training mode, rollback netplay, save states, rewind, run-ahead and libretro shaders. The SHA-1 is of MAME's kinst.chd; no game files are included, players supply their own.
